newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Investment Bank loans $480 mln to industry.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Investment Bank loans $480 mln to industry.

text.p: The Saudi Investment Bank on Tuesday said it extended almost 1.8 billion riyals ($480 million) in loans to the kingdom's industrial sector.
That marked a rise of nearly 37 percent over the bank's loans to the industrial sector the previous year.
It said in a statement that of the total loans and advances made last year, 40 percent went to Saudi industries.
The Riyadh-based bank is owned by Saudi investors and several Saudi and foreign banks including Chase Manhattan Corp and Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd.
